text: RAGForge is a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system. It ingests documents, creates embeddings, and retrieves context for LLM answers. The vector store improves answer relevance.

# FAQ ## What is RAG? RAG combines retrieval and generation. ## Why use chunking? Chunking splits long documents into smaller pieces for better retrieval. ## What is embedding? An embedding is a numeric vector representation of text.
RAGForge Docs RAGForge Documentation This page explains ingestion, indexing, and querying workflows. Supported formats include TXT, Markdown, HTML, and PDF.
